scope: Same-family restore of the verified v5 paused cron/queue snapshot onto fresh volumes on one local Linux arm64 classic-overlay2 Docker engine. Native holds before ingress, explicit observation and verified recovery acknowledgment, continued background pause, explicit queue/cron resume and old occurrence preservation. This is not due, retry, older-snapshot or full recovery-family acceptance.

probeCorrectionsAndRetainedFailures.reason: Probe compared the ordering of a complete source-volume inventory; names and multiplicity match exactly.
Probe invoked durable ingress-last startup with cold backend services still running. The launcher requires all retained services stopped before it checks both stores.
Native process inventory was sampled during the declared 15-second supervisor startup delay. Durable startup had completed with routes withheld; the probe must wait for native process creation.

Cron recovery had been acknowledged with dispatch still paused. The probe then encountered an unknown queue observation with pending recovery and paused delivery intent after startup warming; it must explicitly observe each background app before acknowledgment.

limitations: The source snapshot had already confirmed paused background controls; it contained no armed due timer or pending retry.
Native backends ran cold while controller and gateway remained unstarted. They were then stopped for normal ingress-last startup; the probe waited for the declared supervisor lease delay.
Startup retained an unknown queue observation while recovery and paused intent stayed in force. The operator explicitly observed each app before acknowledging recovery.

HTTP withholding and availability were asserted by the archived executed driver; this receipt retains native data observations and the final independently checked authority pair rather than raw per-request HTTP checkpoints.

The preservation audit compares 350 earlier container states with an authoritative pre-fourth-attempt snapshot. Eight fourth-attempt containers were verified stopped with FinishedAt before the fifth inputs record, then checked unchanged. The supplemental baseline was assembled after the fifth attempt began; it excludes fifth-attempt resources. All 484 prior volumes remain present.
All four earlier failed attempts remain separate failed records with stopped retained containers and volumes. They reflect corrected probe assumptions, not accepted recovery runs.
No per-worker CPU quota, exactly-once external effects, power-loss or broader density/performance qualification is claimed.
